# Kinexus - Network Relationship Manager - Project Setup

## Project Overview
A lightweight personal CRM for career networking with category-based organization, fast data entry, and LinkedIn CSV import.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 18 + Vite
- UI: Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
- State: React Context API
- Backend: Firebase (Firestore + Auth)
- Routing: React Router
